source: With the default {0}, a file starts with the locale code as its top-level key. The preset reads the messages under that key, in YAML and JSON files whose name ends with {1}, {2} or {3}:
text: 使用默认的 {0} 时，文件以语言代码作为顶层键开头。预设会读取该键下的消息，文件为 YAML 和 JSON 文件，文件名以 {1}、{2} 或 {3} 结尾：
